newsitem.title: EU: EC REPORT WEEKLY DIARY FOR MONDAY, OCT 7-SUNDAY, OCT 13.
newsitem.headline: EC REPORT WEEKLY DIARY FOR MONDAY, OCT 7-SUNDAY, OCT 13.

text.p: HIGHLIGHTS
LUXEMBOURG - EU research ministers meet (Monday); exchange of views on the fifth framework programme on research and the financial supplement to the fourth framework programme.
BRUSSELS - Inter-governmental representatives meet (Monday-Tuesday); main discussions focus on CFSP and future defence.
BRUSSELS - Russian Security Chief Alexander Lebed and NATO Secretary General Javier Solana hold joint news conference (Monday).
LUXEMBOURG - EU industry ministers meet (Tuesday); exchange of views on recent actions undertaken by the Commission in the field of the information society.
BRUSSELS - European Commission holds regular weekly meeting (Wednesday); debate on Commission's 1997 work programme and Commissioner Flynn's annual report on employment.
BRUSSELS - European Commissioner Fischler holds news conference on BSE.
AUSTRIA - Austria holds its first elections to the European Parliament, electing 21 deputies (Sunday).
MONDAY, OCTOBER 7
LUXEMBOURG (EXPANDED ITEM) - Research Council (1000/0800).
Agenda includes:
- (over lunch) Exchange of views on the financial supplement to the fourth framework programme/task forces.
The proposal is based on a substantial increase of the ceiling of category 3 of the financial perspectives (internal EU policies).

- First exchange of views on the next framework programme on the basis of a Commission communication "Inventing tomorrow - Europe's research at the service of its people" in the view of the fifth RTD framework programme extended over the years 1998-2001.
- Research on BSE and related human diseases.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commissioner Monti attends high level meeting on taxation.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commissioner Brittan meets Hong Kong State Secretary for Finances Donald Tsang.
BRUSSELS (EXPANDED ITEM) - Inter-governmental representatives meet (and Tuesday); main discussions focus on CFSP and future defence. European Commissioner Oreja attends.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Following EP committees meet:
(1500/1300 GMT) Youth;
Development;
Civil Liberties
Budgetary Control;
Institutional Affairs.

BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Russian Security Chief Alexander Lebed meets NATO Secretary General Javier Solana (1025/0825 GMT); attends North Atlantic Council (1500/1300 GMT); holds joint news conference with NATO Secretary General Javier Solana at 1620/1420 GMT.

BRUSSELS - European Environmental Bureau (EEB) holds conference on "Agrisystems for sustainability" - the EU contribution to the global food security conference and the restructuring of the EU agricultural budget (0900/0700 GMT). Venue: Auditorium of the Credit Communal de Belgique, 2 rue de Ligne. Contact: EEB (322) 539 0037.
TUESDAY, OCTOBER 8
LUXEMBOURG (EXPANDED ITEM) - Industry Council (1000/0800 GMT).
Agenda includes:
- (1200/1000 GMT) Joint meeting with central and eastern European countries ministers; main discussions focus on the information society.
- Exchange of views on recent actions undertaken by the Commission in the field of the information society including:
- The information society: from Korfu to Dublin/The new emerging priorities and the implication of the information society for EU policies;
- Standardisation and the global information society: The European approach;
- Green paper: Living and working in the information society: people first;
- Proposal for directive on regulatory transparency in the internal market for information society services.
- Draft Council resolution on new priorities regarding the information society.

- Multiannual programme to promote the linguistic diversity of Europe in the information society in order to ensure that the benefits of an information society are not denied to those citizens who cannot express themselves easily in the languages whose use tends to increase with the advance of the information society.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commissioner Pinheiro meets Swaziland Prime Minister Sibusiso Dlamini.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commissioner Van Miert meets Belgian Public Administration Minister Andre Flahaut; meets German Economy Minister Guenther Rexrodt.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commission President Santer and Commissioner Van Miert meet Confederation of British Industries (CBI) Chairman Colin Marshall.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Following EP committees meet:
(0900/0700 GMT) Youth;
Development;
Sub-Monetary - European Commissioner de Silguy attends;
Civil Liberties;
Budgetary Control;
Institutional Affairs;
(1500/1300 GMT) Social Affairs - European Commissioner Flynn attends;
Environment;
Youth - European Commissioner Oreja attends;
Development;
Institutional Affairs - European Commissioner Orja attends;
Fisheries.
MONS, Belgium (NEW ITEM) - Russian Security Chief Alexander Lebed attends meeting at SHAPE.

BRUSSELS - Centre for European Policy Studies (CEPS) holds lunchtime on "The EP: lobbying and members' interest" (1315/115 GMT). Speaker is: MEP Glynn Ford. Venue: place du Congres 1. Contact: Anne-Marie Boudou (322) 229 3911.

LONDON - Agra Europe holds third annual European meat industry conference "Meat '96". Topics include: EU policy for meat and livestock; EU policy, European meat production and trade - perspectives from UK and Germany; market outlook for beef, sheepmeat, pigmeat and poultry; BSE and the effects on European meat consumption; rebuilding the image of meat; regaining consumer confidence. Venue: Copthorne Tara Hotel. Contact: Agra Europe (44) 1892 51 18 07.
WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 9
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commission holds regular weekly meeting.
Provisional agenda includes:
- European Commissioner Bangemann presents communication on industrial competitiveness.
- Debate on Commission's 1997 work programme.
- European Commissioner Flynn presents annual report on employment.
- European Commissioners Monti, Gradin and Liikanen present interim report on customs transit.
- European Commissioner Fischler communication on Austrian agri-environment.
- Relations with Turkmenistan and (possibly) Turkey.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commissioner Fischler holds news conference on BSE at 1245/1045 GMT.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commissioner Van Miert meets Spanish Telecoms Minister Rafael Arias Saldago.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Following EP committees meet:
(0900/0700 GMT) Social Affairs;
Environment;
Youth;
Development;
Fisheries;
(1500/1300 GMT) Energy;
External Economic Relations - European Commissioner Bangemann attends;
Rules of Procedure - European Commissioner Oreja attends;
Petitions;
Inquiry into Fraud.

BRUSSELS - Eurelectric, the European Grouping of the Electricity Supply Industry Chairman Niek Ketting holds news conference on the common position on the internal electricity market and the implementation of the directive in the member states (1400/1200 GMT). Venue: Dorint Hotel. Contact: Eurelectric, Hughes Belin (322) 501 1208.
THURSDAY, OCTOBER 10
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commissioner Bonino holds news conference on multi-annual guidelines in fisheries at 1300/1100 GMT.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Following EP committees meet:
(0900/0700 GMT) Energy;
External Economic Relations European Commissioner Brittan attends;
Regional Policy - European Commissioner Wulf-Mathies attends;
Rules of Procedure;
Petitions;
(1500/1300 GMT) Social Affairs.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Polish Foreign Minister Dariusz Rosati meets European Commissioner Brittan; NATO Secretary General Javier Solana and WEU Secretary General Jose Cutileiro.

BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Association of Craft, Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises (UEAPME) holds news conference on "Justice within the social dialogue" (1100/0900 GMT). Venue: UEAPME, 4 rue Jacques de Lalaing. Contact: UEAPME (322) 230 7599.

BRUSSELS - The European Association of Aerospace Industries (AECMA) holds evening lecture on "European aerospace and strategies and perspectives" (1815/1615 GMT). Venue: Italian Embassy, 43 avenue Legrand. Contact: AECMA (322) 775 8110.

BRUSSELS - Cogen Europe holds third annual conference on "Europe's cogeneration markets of the future: prospects and challenges" (and Friday). Venue: Sheraton Hotel. Contact: Cogen Europe (322) 772 8290.
FRIDAY, OCTOBER 11
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Following EP committee meets:
(1500/1300 GMT) External Economic Relations.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Polish Foreign Minister Dariusz Rosati holds news conference ar 1600/1400 GMT. Venue: Polish Embassy, 29 avenue des Gaulois.

BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Canadian Ambassador to the EU Juneau holds news conference on "EU fur import prohibition" (1100/0900 GMT). Venue: International Press Centre (IPC). Contact: Annie Bollaert, Canadian Mission to the EU (322) 741 0675.

BRUSSELS - European Institute for Asian Studies (EIAS) holds conference on "APEC and the EU". Main discussions focus on what APEC is, what it actually does and what it means for EU policy and business makers. Contact: EIAS, Kerstin Bergloef (322) 230 8122.

AMSTERDAM (NEW ITEM) - World Federation of Advertisers (WFA) and Association of Dutch Advertisers hold joint conference on "Commercial communciations and self-regulation in Europe" (0830/0630 GMT). Venue: The Grand Hotel, 197 Oudezijds Voorburgwal. Contact: WFA (31) 20 661 4066.
SATURDAY, OCTOBER 12
BEIJING (NEW ITEM) - European Commissioner Papoutsis on official visit (To October 18); attends EU/China conference on cooperation in energy.
SUNDAY, OCTOBER 13
AUSTRIA - Austria holds its first elections to the European Parliament, electing 21 deputies.
